gloss: in one go, all at once, in a single breath

definitions.gloss: in one go, all at once
definitions.explanation: Doing something completely without stopping or in a single continuous action.
Drinking an entire beverage in one continuous action.

examples.english: I read it all in one go.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}を{一気|いっき}に{駆|か}け{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I ran up the stairs all at once.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{一気|いっき}に{解決|かいけつ}した。
examples.english: I solved the problem all at once.

examples.japanese: ビールを{一気|いっき}に{飲|の}んだ。
{一気|いっき}{飲|の}みは{危険|きけん}だ。
{一気|いっき}コールは{禁止|きんし}されている。

notes:
{一気|いっき} means doing something in one continuous action without pause.

COMMON PATTERNS (Sense 1):
- {一気|いっき}に: in one go, all at once
- {一気|いっき}に{読|よ}む: to read in one sitting
- {一気|いっき}に{書|か}く: to write in one sitting
- {一気|いっき}に{片付|かたづ}ける: to finish all at once
- {一気|いっき}{呵成|かせい}: at one stretch (literary)

DRINKING CONTEXT (Sense 2):
- {一気|いっき}{飲|の}み: chugging
- {一気|いっき}コール: chanting to encourage chugging
- This practice is discouraged due to health risks

Note: In recent years, many universities have banned {一気|いっき}{飲|の}み} due to alcohol-related accidents.
